title: Wrap RewardMilestoneService/StreakService/StreakStateProvider in @riverpod providers instead of constructing them ad-hoc at every call site
rule: SM-7 (repositories/services/DAOs constructed only inside their @riverpod provider; no ad-hoc construction/service-locator lookups)

evidence.quote:
_provider = StreakStateProvider(
        db: db,
        clock: const SystemLocalDayClock(),

why: No @riverpod/Provider wraps RewardMilestoneService, StreakService, or StreakStateProvider anywhere in the codebase (grep confirms zero matches for 'Provider<RewardMilestoneService>' etc.); instead `RewardMilestoneService(db, profileId: profileId)` is repeated at 12 call sites repo-wide (7 inside this batch alone across 4 files, plus reward_config_controller.dart has 4 separate occurrences of the identical two-line construction), and StreakService/StreakStateProvider follow the same pattern. Every call site must independently obtain a UserDatabase and profileId and re-derive the same object graph. A constructor signature change, a swap of the SharedPreferences-backed store, or a test override all require touching every call site instead of one provider. It also means these classes can only be faked in tests by injecting a fake UserDatabase all the way through, not by a single ProviderScope override.
recommendation: Introduce rewardMilestoneServiceProvider / streakServiceProvider @riverpod providers (mirroring the existing, correct pointsServiceProvider pattern in points_providers.dart) and have every listed call site use ref.watch/ref.read of the provider instead of constructing directly.
acceptance_criteria: A single @riverpod provider exists for each of RewardMilestoneService, StreakService, and StreakStateProvider
All 9 in-batch construction sites (and the additional sites in dashboard/learning/sync features) are replaced with ref.watch/ref.read of the provider
Existing service unit tests continue to pass by overriding the provider rather than constructing the service directly
